discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and the development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic hormone discovery to drugs with very large effects on diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular outcomes. The trio already won the 2024 Lasker and the 2024 Breakthrough Prize, and recent prizes show the committee rewards basic discoveries with clear clinical payoff.
